meta.name: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
meta.description: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn's future shatters when he awakens the so-called "defective" Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the "weakest" class.

videos.title: I'm Elymas the Heavy Knight
videos.overview: Elymas Edvaughn is disowned by his father for becoming a Heavy Knight.

videos.title: Menacing Foul Eight-Legged Beast
videos.overview: Elymas uses his wits and game knowledge to defeat a much more powerful monster.

videos.title: The Raid Quest
videos.overview: Elymas finds himself surrounded by fearful newbies and an arrogant veteran on his first Raid Quest.

videos.title: Existence Evolution
videos.overview: With Gowtan paralyzed, Elymas must survive against the Mad Headder until he can get back in the fight.

videos.title: Fang of Smoldering Insanity
videos.overview: Elymas goes shopping for a skillbook only to discover they're prohibitively expensive.

videos.title: Ruche the Pierrot
videos.overview: Elymas begs Ruche to join his party so he can use her skills to find the item he needs.

videos.title: Golden Raana Farming
videos.overview: Elymas uses his game knowledge to exploit the weaknesses of the elusive Golden Raana.

videos.title: Wandering
videos.overview: Elymas and Ruche's celebration is interrupted by a wandering dungeon boss.

videos.title: Dreamlord
videos.overview: Ruche returns to save Elymas from a desperate situation, and they make one last gamble to beat the Dreamlord.

videos.title: Negotiation
videos.overview: Elymas and Ruche celebrate their payout and promotion and return to the shady shop for a Skill Book.

videos.title: Inescapable Past
videos.overview: Elymas' father hears about his success and visits the guild with Malice, who has a twisted attachment to him.

videos.title: Malice the Master Swordsman
videos.overview: Elymas activates the true power of the Heavy Knight to make a comeback against Malice.

videos.title: Lacoryna, City of Adventurers
videos.overview: After defeating Malice and saying goodbye to his father, Elymas visits Lacoryna, the holy land of adventurers.

videos.title: Mythril Giant
videos.overview: Elymas and Ruche take on an overpowering foe in hopes of acquiring powerful materials.

videos.title: Dreamlord of the Dreamhole
videos.overview: With their new skills gained on level up, Elymas and Ruche decide to take on the Rock Centipede.

videos.title: No Defense Spared
videos.overview: The Rock Centipede Existence Evolves into a Death Amude, trapping Elymas and Ruche in a desperate situation.

videos.title: Guildmaster Hailenn
videos.overview: Elymas is unsettled by the Dreamlord’s Existence Evolution, so he asks to meet with the guildmaster.

videos.title: Blacksmith Veruga
videos.overview: In order to process the mythril they acquired, Elymas and Ruche visit a skilled blacksmith.

videos.title: Empress of the Angler Clan
videos.overview: Elymas is challenged to a fishing contest by the leader of the Sea Dragon’s Fang angler clan.

videos.title: Magic Swordsman Hilde
videos.overview: Elymas and Ruche return to pick up their sword and discover that someone else is trying to buy it.

videos.title: Blackened Flameblade
videos.overview: Carlos, who is investigating the monster disasters in the area, invites Elymas and Ruche on a Raid Quest.

videos.title: Hunter Kelt and Priest Maebel
videos.overview: Elymas and Ruche team up with new members, but a minor conflict leads to tension within the party.
